method: One explicit initial inspection on the mapped village road before the bridge. Native W/Shift inputs and camera headings only; real wall clock, no position changes or replay during recording. Round trip includes stop/restart and run on return. Audio, when enabled, is the game post-limiter stream. Baseline film inspects only the village approach, ending at the bridge or the first obstruction.
